SELECT 
    u.order_id,
    u.customer_name,
    u.customer_email,
    u.customer_phone,
    TO_CHAR(u.pickup_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pickup_date,
    u.pickup_time,
    u.total_price,
    u.notes,
    u.paid_at,
    COALESCE(
        ARRAY(
            SELECT json_build_object(
                'product_name', pt.name,
                'variant_name', pvt.name,
                'quantity', oi.quantity,
                'unit_price', oi.unit_price,
                'is_gluten_free', oi.is_gluten_free,
                'is_lactose_free', oi.is_lactose_free,
                'dolibarr_id', pv.dolibarr_id,
                'dolibarr_gluten_id', pv.dolibarr_gluten_id,

const page = msg.page || 1; 
const perPage = 5; 

const offset = (page - 1) * perPage;

msg.queryParameters = [msg.userId, perPage, offset];
msg.payload = `
    SELECT 
        c.id,
        c.name,
        c.birthday,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, c.birthday)) as current_age,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM c.birthday) || ' ' || 
        CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.birthday)
            WHEN 1 THEN 'січня'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'лютого'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'березня'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'квітня'
            WHEN 5 THEN 'травня'
            WHEN 6 THEN 'червня'
            WHEN 7 THEN 'липня'
            WHEN 8 THEN 'серпня'
            WHEN 9 THEN 'вересня'
            WHEN 10 THEN 'жовтня'
            WHEN 11 THEN 'листопада'
            WHEN 12 THEN 'грудня'
        END as birthday_short,
        COUNT(*) OVER() as total_count
    FROM contacts c
    WHERE c.user_id = $1
      AND c.deleted = FALSE
    ORDER BY
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.birthday),
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM c.birthday),
        c.name
    LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
`;

msg.listParams = {
    page: page,
    perPage: perPage,
    chatId: msg.chatId
};

return msg;

msg.payload = `
SELECT
    pt.name AS product_name,
    pvt.name AS variant_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT oi.is_gluten_free AND NOT oi.is_lactose_free THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS normal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_gluten_free THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS gluten_free_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_lactose_free THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS lactose_free_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN product_translations pt
    ON oi.product_id = pt.product_id
    AND pt.language_code = 'es'
LEFT JOIN product_variant_translations pvt
    ON oi.product_variant_id = pvt.variant_id
    AND pvt.language_code = 'es'
WHERE o.pickup_date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid')::DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'
    AND o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY pt.name, pvt.name
ORDER BY pt.name, pvt.name;
`;

msg.payload = `
WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE orders 
    SET status = $2
    WHERE order_id = $1 
    RETURNING *
)
SELECT 
    u.order_id,
    u.customer_name,
    u.customer_email,
    u.customer_phone,
    TO_CHAR(u.pickup_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pickup_date,
    u.pickup_time,
    u.total_price,
    u.notes,
    u.paid_at,
    COALESCE(
        ARRAY(
            SELECT json_build_object(
                'product_name', pt.name,
                'variant_name', pvt.name,
                'quantity', oi.quantity,
                'unit_price', oi.unit_price,
                'is_gluten_free', oi.is_gluten_free,
                'is_lactose_free', oi.is_lactose_free,
                'dolibarr_id', pv.dolibarr_id,
                'dolibarr_gluten_id', pv.dolibarr_gluten_id,
                'dolibarr_lactose_id', pv.dolibarr_lactose_id,
                'price_tax_free', pv.price_tax_free,
                'price_tax_free_gluten', pv.price_tax_free_gluten,
                'price_tax_free_lactose', pv.price_tax_free_lactose
            )
            FROM order_items oi
            LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON oi.product_variant_id = pv.id
            LEFT JOIN product_translations pt ON oi.product_id = pt.product_id  AND pt.language_code = $3
            LEFT JOIN product_variant_translations pvt ON oi.product_variant_id = pvt.variant_id AND pvt.language_code = $3
            WHERE oi.order_id = u.id
            ORDER BY oi.id
        ),
        '{}'
    ) AS items
FROM updated u;
`;

return msg;

name: product
func:
const id = 6;
const lang = 'en';

msg.queryParameters = [id, lang];
msg.payload = `
    SELECT 
        p.id, 
        pt.name, 
        p.slug, 
        pt.description, 
        p.images, 
        pt.allergens, 
        p.available,
        p.category_id AS "categoryId",
        p.is_posible_gluten_free AS "isPosibleGlutenFree",
        p.is_posible_lactose_free AS "isPosibleLactoseFree",
        p.is_posible_sugar_free AS "isPosibleSugarFree",
        p.is_cake_of_the_month AS "isCakeOfTheMonth",
        p.created_at AS "createdAt",
        COALESCE(
            json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'id', pv.id,
                    'name', pvt.name,
                    'measures', pv.measures,
                    'weightGrams', pv.weight_grams,
                    'price', pv.price,
                    'sortOrder', pv.sort_order
                ) ORDER BY pv.sort_order ASC
            ) FILTER (WHERE pv.id IS NOT NULL),
            '[]'
        ) AS variants
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN product_translations pt ON p.id = pt.product_id AND pt.language_code = $2
    LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_variant_translations pvt ON pv.id = pvt.variant_id AND pvt.language_code = $2
    WHERE p.id = $1
    GROUP BY p.id, pt.name, pt.description, pt.allergens
`;

return msg;
